dimensions.capture: exact integer CSS dimensions at x=0,y=0,scale=1 with beyond-viewport capture
dimensions.transforms: no resize, fit, translation, registration, or alignment search

color.output: top-left-row-major straight-alpha sRGB RGBA8 with zero RGB at alpha zero

lifecycle.ready: parse complete, all admitted images decoded, document.fonts.ready
lifecycle.updates: two Page.captureScreenshot lifecycle updates followed by one canonical capture
lifecycle.animation: initial sample and declared integer-microsecond offsets from the fresh resource-ready epoch

time.installation: CDP virtual time installed before navigation
time.resource_ready_policy: pause at the fresh resource-ready epoch
time.capture: clock remains paused through lifecycle updates and capture

fonts.policy: validate declared WOFF2 digest and CSS face metadata before navigation; every used SVG text font must then be custom embedded according to CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode
fonts.qualification_assets: no text and no declared font faces

images.policy: only case-declared canonical-base64 PNG, APNG, JPEG/JFIF, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, AVIF, or sanitized nested SVG payload identities may complete before capture
images.qualification_assets: no image elements and no declared data assets

resources.routing: deny by default; only http://reference.invalid/input.svg is fulfilled for this qualification

state.process: fresh Chromium process for every artifact and repeat
state.context: fresh browser context, page, cache, document, and virtual clock
state.sharing: official and candidate inputs share no mutable viewer state

restrictions: The first qualification case declares no font or image assets.
Cases with text or images must supply a closed declaration that binds embedded source identity, face metadata or canonical image identity, and reviewed local bytes.
